name: UZH-FPV Drone Racing Dataset
summary: 专家操控竞速无人机的激烈运动序列，提供相机、事件、IMU 和激光跟踪运动真值。
summaryEn: Aggressive expert-piloted drone sequences with cameras, events, IMU, and laser-tracked motion truth.
scale: Indoor and outdoor racing and obstacle-flight sequences
scaleZh: 室内外竞速及障碍飞行序列
organizations: University of Zurich Robotics and Perception Group
organizationsZh: 苏黎世大学机器人与感知研究组
access: Official sequence downloads; benchmark test truth withheld
accessZh: 官方序列下载；基准测试真值不公开
verdict: 激烈飞行下的未来观测
wmNote: 可研究高速自运动下的时序观测和轨迹预测；不将 IMU 信号当作执行器控制。
wmNoteEn: Supports fast egomotion and trajectory prediction; IMU signals are not actuator controls.

evidence.statement: Aggressive flight sequences provide visual-inertial measurements and 6DoF ground-truth trajectories.
